artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.1 × 4 cm (2 × 1 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rural scene with various figures and animals. The artwork showcases human figures in different poses, some kneeling or gesturing toward others seated on a throne-like structure under a thatched roof supported by columns. A small dog is in the foreground, exploring the ground. To the right, a figure tends to a vessel, and behind, figures gather or parade, holding flags. The background features a shining star in the sky, clouds, and a suggestion of rolling fields or mountains, adding to a sense of narrative depth and activity. The etching technique gives a detailed appearance to the composition.

artworks.title: Christ in Limbo
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 3.5 × 3.6 cm (1 3/8 × 1 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in a dark cave-like setting. An ethereal figure, enveloped in light with a halo, extends a hand toward a group of skeletal and pleading figures emerging from what appears to be a tomb or underworld. Above them, another figure with wings appears to be descending or floating in an open sky. The detailed linework emphasizes the contrast between light and shadow, suggesting a narrative of salvation or deliverance. The mood is dramatic and filled with movement, capturing the atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: The Descent of the Holy Dove
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 3.5 × 3.7 cm (1 3/8 × 1 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a room with figures gathered around a central seated figure highlighted by an aura. The seated figure wears a robe and gestures with their hands. Other individuals stand or kneel in a semicircle around them in poses of observation or reverence. The figures' faces are minimally detailed. The ceiling has a bird-like shape emitting light downwards. The room has brick-patterned walls and two window-like openings. The scene is enclosed in a circular frame.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 3.5 × 3.7 cm (1 3/8 × 1 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene within a circle. The central figure is surrounded by others, with one figure radiating a luminous aura. The scene depicts a group gathered around a reclining figure. The figures are within a cave-like setting, enclosed within the circular boundary of the image. The shading and lines in the drawing create depth and texture, emphasizing the central figure's glow, contrasting with the surrounding dark, textured environment.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5 × 3.9 cm (1 15/16 × 1 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person kneeling at a prayer bench in an arched room. They are on the right, facing an angel-like figure on the left. The person wears a robe with their hair styled in an updo and partially covered by a headscarf. There is a small cloth or pillow on the floor beside them. The angelic figure floats mid-air on a cloud with wings extended, pointing a finger toward the person. The settings include a bed with ornate drapery and tall columns. The floor has a patterned tile surface. A bright, circular light with a dove at its center shines above the angel. The scene is enclosed within an oval frame.

artworks.title: Christ among the Doctors
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5 × 3.7 cm (1 15/16 × 1 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene featuring a grand domed hall with classical columns and arches. In the center, a figure is seated on a throne surrounded by other figures engaged in a gathering. The arched dome is intricately detailed with decorative patterns, and the walls are lined with columns. The floor is checkered, and the composition is circular, creating a sense of focus and symmetry. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of Renaissance art.

artworks.title: The Circumcision
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.1 × 3.8 cm (2 × 1 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with figures gathered around a central table. The drawing features a circular composition of an interior setting with ornate columns framing the scene. In the center, a round table is surrounded by figures engaged in an activity. Fine line work is used to depict intricate patterns and textures, emphasizing architectural details and clothing folds. The atmosphere conveys a sense of solemnity and importance.

artworks.title: Presentation in the Temple
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5 × 4.1 cm (1 15/16 × 1 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical architectural setting with elaborate structures and human figures engaged in a communal activity. The scene is enclosed within an oval framework and depicts a richly detailed architectural interior featuring numerous columns and a vaulted ceiling. The flooring has a patterned design, and a focal point of the drawing is a central table where a group of people are gathered. The scene suggests an event of significance, possibly a ceremonial or religious gathering, underscored by the solemn and formal arrangement of the figures. The artist exhibits a keen sense of perspective and depth, capturing intricate details of the architecture and its ornamentation.

artworks.title: The Ascension
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 3.5 × 3.6 cm (1 3/8 × 1 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a circular depiction with a central figure elevated in the sky, arms outstretched above a group of people. The central figure has lightly sketched facial features and a halo, wearing long, flowing robes. The people on the ground wear robes and some have halos, showing various poses of worship and reverence. The background features a stylized sky with clouds.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 3.5 × 3.6 cm (1 3/8 × 1 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The scene depicts three crosses on a hill with figures gathered around in an emblematic style. The linework and hatching create depth in a circular composition. The background has a stylized sky with radiating lines. The figures are in a classical style, with halos around some characters. The tone is monochrome, highlighting intricate details and skilled draftsmanship typical of emblematic and religious illustrations.

artworks.title: Descent from the Cross
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 3.6 × 3.5 cm (1 7/16 × 1 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring crosses on a hill. The image shows a detailed depiction of a crucifixion scene with three prominent crosses. Two ladders are leaning against the central cross, and figures are shown on the ladders. In the foreground, there are figures in various emotive poses, some kneeling and others standing, wearing robes. The circular frame gives a haloed appearance to the scene. The background suggests a distant landscape with faint architectural elements, all intricately sketched.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 3.4 × 3.6 cm (1 5/16 × 1 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a central figure ascending towards the sky surrounded by figures in varied poses. The figure is rising upwards, emitting rays of light. They are positioned above several figures on the ground, some of whom appear to be reaching or gesturing towards the ascending figure. The scene conveys a sense of motion and exaltation, with the figures on the ground appearing to react. The circular border frames the image, concentrating the viewer's focus on the ascending figure and the surrounding activity. The style of the drawing includes meticulous line work and shading, emphasizing the dynamic postures and expressions of the figures.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for Callot's "The New Testament"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate text plaque with decorative elements. The central focus is a plaque inscribed with text in French, surrounded by elaborate scrollwork and decorative motifs, including a cherubic face at the top. The design incorporates flowing curves, ribbons, and two cruciform shapes on either side. The artistry is detailed with a sense of depth created by the intricate linework and shading.

artworks.title: Christ Disputing with the Doctors
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.6 × 8.8 cm (2 5/8 × 3 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with a central figure speaking. The interior features high arches, columns, and an elevated figure seated under a canopy surrounded by a crowd of listeners. The listeners are dispersed throughout the drawing, creating depth. Richly detailed drapery and classical architectural elements enhance the grandeur of the scene.

artworks.title: Fisher of Men
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.4 × 8.1 cm (2 1/2 × 3 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a coastal scene with a boat near the foreground, individuals engaged in activities like hauling nets. A figure is positioned at the center, possibly addressing a group on the shore. The horizon is low in the scene, with more boats and a distant coastline visible for depth. Rocky formations on the right feature more people, adding to the sense of activity. The drawing style includes fine line work for detailed intricacy. The color scheme is limited to paper and ink tones, creating a monochromatic effect. Urban structures or forts are suggested in the background near the shore, enhancing the coastal ambiance.

artworks.title: Jesus with the Pharisees
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.5 × 8.2 cm (2 9/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing multiple people gathering in a field. The foreground includes figures among tall sheaves of wheat, with some bending down. In the background, there are rolling hills, trees, and a structure resembling a castle or church tower. The scene features black lines and shading, possibly indicating a pen drawing or etching. Tall trees frame the sides, and one figure is gesturing to others.

artworks.title: Sermon on the Mount
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 8.5 cm (2 1/2 × 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a depiction of a group of people gathered in a natural setting. The scene shows several figures sitting or standing on the grass in a hilly landscape, with a central figure seated on a rock, gesturing to the others. This figure is emitting light from their head. The group seems to be engaged in a moment of teaching or discussion. The scene is surrounded by trees, and hilly terrain is visible in the background, adding depth to the composition. The style of drawing is linear and detailed, with attention to garment folds and natural textures.

artworks.title: Christ and the Woman Taken in Adultery
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.4 × 8.7 cm (2 1/2 × 3 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural and human scene. The drawing depicts numerous figures gathered in an architectural setting with grand columns and structured buildings. The figures are dressed in flowing robes and elaborate headwear. There is a central interaction or event catching everyone's attention. The background includes an arched passageway and multiple structures, indicating a complex urban environment. The cross-hatching technique is used to add depth and detail to the image.

artworks.title: Stoning of Jesus
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.4 × 8.5 cm (2 1/2 × 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a classical architectural setting. The image depicts figures around a grand architectural structure with large columns and arched openings. The figures are dressed in long robes and appear engaged in an active scene with gestures. One figure is in a central position, emitting an aura. The architecture is detailed with cross-hatching, creating depth and shadow.

artworks.title: Raising of Lazarus
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.5 × 8.7 cm (2 9/16 × 3 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a cave or rock enclosure with multiple figures. The image displays a group of individuals gathered around a central figure who appears to be reclining on a cloth or low bed. The setting is inside a natural stone cave, with detailed textures indicating rock formations and archways. The figures in the foreground are depicted in long, flowing robes, with some standing attentively and others seated or kneeling, adding depth and dimension to the composition. The intricate use of line and shading brings out the folds of the garments and the ruggedness of the rocky surroundings, conveying a sense of drama and focus on the central recumbent figure.

artworks.title: The Entry into Jerusalem
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.7 × 8.2 cm (2 5/8 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical procession. The black and white etching depicts a scene where a large group of robed figures are gathered around a central figure on a donkey. The figures are holding branches, possibly palm leaves, which arch above to form a canopy. The backdrop features intricate architecture with walls, towers, and buildings. The composition is busy and dynamic, with figures in various poses of engagement, indicating depth through layering and perspective.

artworks.title: Caesar's Coin
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.5 × 8.6 cm (2 9/16 × 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural and urban scene, featuring figures within classical columns and arches. The figures are engaged in various interactions, set against detailed architectural elements in the background. Line work and hatching are used to add texture and depth, enhancing light and shadow in the composition.

artworks.title: Conversion of Paul
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.7 × 8.7 cm (2 5/8 × 3 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with fortified castles in the background. Soldiers on horseback and infantry with spears and banners engage in combat. The sky is dramatic with dark clouds and rays of light shining through. The lines are heavily inked, giving a sense of movement and chaos. The style resembles historical engravings or etchings of battles.

artworks.title: Lady in a Large Coat
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.5 × 8.1 cm (2 3/16 × 3 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length illustrations of the same person from different angles. The individual is standing and slightly turned to one side. They have short hair and wear a hat with a wide brim. The facial features are minimally detailed. The person wears a long gown with voluminous sleeves, a high collar, and additional drapery around the shoulders. There are no visible objects or jewelry, and the background is plain with a textured surface.
